about: Every OpenStreetMap object meeting the box, whole, with its tags, from the planet file of 2026-10-26, read with GeoDesk, without building outlines. Administrative boundaries are simplified to 0.0001 degrees, national parks and protected areas to 0.0005. A Point is a node, a LineString a way, a Polygon or MultiPolygon an area.
